plan_steps.step: Promote selected desktop path to product baseline
evidence: User instruction explicitly rejected initial UI candidate and PoC framing.
Existing Tauri/Rust local/internal build path is already implemented and audited.
Apple notarization and Microsoft signing docs require signing/trust gates for public distribution.
Service readiness registry still lists public blockers.
The old status strings contained dependency-audit/candidate language that could misdirect decisions.

decision: Use product-grade baseline language for the selected desktop path and keep experimental language only for bounded alternative-route research.
